about: Reminder rules (docs/engine.md, "Reminders"; P5.12): from the journal, the local date and wall-clock time now, quiet hours, the most a day, snoozes and a window size, the local dates and times at which reminders should fire, earliest first, each with the reading it is about. Times are wall-clock; no case has an instant or a zone. The plans are invented.

cases.name: the example: at 07:30 on a Friday today's 07:00 has passed, so Monday's is first
the example with quiet hours to 08:00: each moves to 08:00, and today's is still to come
before its time, today's reminder is first
at its very minute a reminder has passed
today's reading is read: no reminder today, and the rest name the next reading
part read is done for today too
a skip leaves today's reminder, for the reading that is now next
a rest day has no reminder
no reminder time: no reminders
a new reminder time counts from its date
reminders turned off from a date: none from then on
a pause with an end: reminders begin again the day it ends
a pause with no end: no reminders
an ended enrollment has no reminders
a sequence gets no more reminders than it has unread readings
a finished plan has no reminders
before the start: the first reminder is on the start date
finish-date: one reminder a reading day, however many readings the day has
finish-date: today's share is read, so today has no reminder
quiet hours across midnight: a late reminder is dropped every day, never held to the morning
quiet hours across midnight: an early reminder moves to their end
quiet hours in the afternoon: a reminder inside them moves to their end
quiet hours end where they begin: there are none
a reminder at the minute quiet hours end is outside them
a reminder at the minute quiet hours begin is inside them
two plans at one time: in the order the plans are listed
the most a day: the earliest are kept
the most a day, with a tie: the plan listed first is kept
the window: the earliest overall
a window of none: no reminders
a snooze: one more reminder at its time, for today's reading
a snooze whose time has passed is dropped
a snooze is dropped once today's reading is read
a snooze into quiet hours that end tomorrow is dropped
a snooze inside the morning's quiet hours moves to their end, where it is the day's own reminder
a snooze past midnight is kept while the reading it was about is unread
a snooze counts toward the most a day
a snooze for an enrollment the journal does not have is ignored
calendar: each reminder names its own date's appointment
calendar: April has no 31st, so no reminder is lost or doubled at the month's end
calendar: an appointment already read ahead gets no reminder
calendar: today's appointment was skipped, so today has no reminder
calendar: a rest day has an appointment and no reminder
the clocks go forward tonight (14 March in Chicago): 07:00 stays 07:00
a reminder at 02:30 on the night 02:30 is skipped is still given at 02:30: the system delivers it at the next minute that exists
the clocks go back tonight (7 November in Chicago): 01:30 happens twice and is one reminder
travel east: it is already evening where the reader landed, so today's 07:00 is left out
travel west across the date line: it is yesterday again, and the reminders start from that date
travel west: it is 05:30 again where the reader landed, so today's 07:00 is still to come
